Path: reSHape Script text -> runScript -> solveDoc -> {OCCT buildDoc, brep-rs measure_doc, phase0 translateDoc -> solidcraft wasm}. the harness re-runs toScript(doc) through runScript and compares sketch planes/offsets/points and blend targets: identical for every rational-coordinate case (rect, circle, offsets, negative gap). Emits loft(sk1, sk2, gap) with the official name. Sections with irrational coordinates (hexagon, rotated squares, diamond) come back rounded to 6 decimals (17.320508 for 17.3205080757), so their points differ by about 1e-7, harmless to the volumes above but not bit-exact. Negative gap normalises to the bottom-first order loft(sk2, sk1, 30).
